name: Umaren'k'sa
description: The Umaren'k'sa were a sentient species from the planet Umaren'k in the Unknown Regions. After another species, the Hemes Arbora, migrated to their world, the Umaren'k'sa adopted much of their visitors' culture, a societal shift that was prompted by the appearance of the sentient planet Zonama Sekot in the Umaren'k system.
